system.history:
A patrol officer trained to secure public spaces, interview witnesses, and coordinate emergency response.

Scene use: First responder, perimeter contact, investigator, evacuation coordinator, or cautious ally facing threats beyond ordinary training.
system.personality: Alert, procedural, and focused on public safety. Decide whether this officer is trusting, skeptical, overwhelmed, or already familiar with unusual incidents.
system.distinguishingFeatures: Uniform, radio, body camera, protective vest, and duty equipment.

system.description: A compact impact tool used at close range.
